summary: Project to build a secure document editor with support for inserting multiple image attachments (PNG/JPG) stored in a canister backend, plus exporting a single chapter to PDF and DOCX with full formatting and embedded images from the canister via a button in the chapter edit view.
architectural_notes: Images inserted into documents must be uploaded and persisted in the canister (backend) for security; support multiple images per document.

Export pipeline must convert chapter rich-text content to PDF/DOCX while preserving formatting and embedding canister-stored images directly (not links), exposed via an export action in the chapter editor UI.
known_issues: Regression in version 52: after login, the “New book” button is greyed out/disabled in draft mode, preventing creation of a new book (works correctly in version 51).
In version 53, exporting a chapter to PDF or DOCX fails with message "export failed" for both empty and non-empty chapters; no file is downloaded (after ~3 seconds).

existing_features.title: Enable inserting images from local files into the rich text editor (ReactQuill) by uploading the file to the canister and embedding a reference in the chapter content so the image renders on subsequent loads.
Render canister-stored images in editor content by resolving embedded image references into displayable URLs/bytes at runtime.
Add React Query hooks for the new attachment APIs and integrate them into the chapter editor flow, including cache invalidation keyed by chapter id.
Add export actions in the chapter edit view to download the currently opened chapter as PDF and as DOCX.
Ensure exported PDF preserves the chapter’s editor formatting (headings, bold/italic, lists, alignment, line breaks) and embeds all chapter images directly in the PDF file (no external links).
Ensure exported DOCX preserves the chapter’s editor formatting (headings, bold/italic, lists, alignment, line breaks) and embeds all chapter images directly in the DOCX file (no external links).

Fix the regression in version 52 where the “New book” button on the Books list page is disabled/greyed out immediately after login, preventing users from creating a new book (it worked in version 51). Update the readiness/disable logic so authenticated users can open the create-book dialog and create a book once the backend actor is available, and ensure the UI does not remain disabled due to user profile loading/absence.

Fix the frontend export flow in the chapter editor so clicking “Export PDF” or “Export DOCX” reliably triggers a file download, and improve error reporting so the user is not left with a generic 'export failed' when the backend call fails.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add ability to insert multiple image attachments (PNG/JPG) directly in the text editor, with images uploaded and stored securely in the canister backend.
Add canister-backed image attachment storage with access control so authenticated users can upload and retrieve multiple PNG/JPG images per chapter.
Define a stable schema for attachments and tie lifecycle to chapters (cleanup on chapter deletion) to prevent orphaned images and uncontrolled growth.
Add export of a single chapter to PDF with exact editor formatting preserved and images embedded directly in the file; provide an export button in the chapter edit view.
Add export of a single chapter to DOCX with exact editor formatting preserved and images embedded directly in the file; provide an export button in the chapter edit view.
Fix the backend export APIs so exporting a chapter as PDF or DOCX succeeds for both empty and non-empty chapters and returns a downloadable binary payload to the frontend.

projectName: Insert and store multiple image attachments (PNG/JPG) inside the chapter text editor
